_comment: Starting point for a new Lab experiment. Copy this file to something like lab-experiment.N-slug.json, fill in every field, then render with: python3 scripts/render_template.py templates/lab-experiment.template.html templates/data/lab-experiment.N-slug.json lab/N/index.html — review the output, then push it through the normal GitHub upload flow like any other page.

page.title: [Page title] | Lab | Dr. Paul Ress, DBA
page.meta_description: [One or two sentences for search results and social previews.]
page.social_description: [Optional shorter variant for Twitter — reuse meta_description if no shorter version is needed.]

h1: [The question this experiment asks, stated as a question]
lede: [One or two sentences setting up what this experiment actually is and why it's worth running.]
hypothesis_text: [The claim, stated plainly, before the evidence — specific enough that it could turn out to be wrong.]
finding_text: [What actually happened, or where the test currently stands.]
limitations_text: [Optional one-line honesty check — sample size, single-subject, still running, etc. Remove this field entirely to omit the line.]

flow_steps.title: [Step one]
flow_steps.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/></svg>

flow_steps.title: [Step two]
flow_steps.body: [What happened next. Add or remove flow_steps entries freely.]
flow_steps.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/></svg>

experiment_lede: [Describe the artifact and link to it if it's live — the tangible thing this experiment produced.]
stats_line: [The real numbers — pages, time, whatever's actually measurable for this experiment.]
constraint_text: [Judgment call the AI couldn't make, or where it drifted.]
finding_statement: [The honest, specific thing that surprised you — not a generic AI take.]
finding_support: [Optional one supporting sentence. Remove this field entirely to omit the line.]
finding_support_2: [Optional second supporting sentence — a distinct, concrete point the first line didn't cover. Remove this field entirely to omit the line.]
implication_text: [What you believe the finding means for marketing — the "so what," one sentence.]
takeaway_text: [The primary, quotable takeaway — what a reader should do differently because of this.]
next_question_lede: [What's still unresolved, teasing whatever comes next.]
